regime_context: China A-shares show a narrowing leadership structure: only 6 of 22 themes are trend-gate eligible, with AI Compute & Optics as the single dominant narrative (rank 1, score 1.47) absorbing 32% of flow, while the rotation breadth view is 'narrowing' and non-directional. The backtest verdict is explicit that this market's absolute-trend gate did NOT reduce drawdown (gate_helps=false, mean-reverting tape), and cross-sectional rank-IC is ~0 — so this detector is display-only and any leans must be humbly expressed as conditionals, not alpha claims.
emerging_watch: Watch Gold Miners (rank 2, score 0.812, but eligible=false) — if it crosses into trend-gate eligibility (passes its absolute trend filter) while AI Compute fails its own, that would mark a confirmed leadership handoff toward defensives. Retire this watch if Gold Miners remain ineligible for 20 more trading days.

theses.subject: AI Compute & Optics
theses.thesis: The only theme with both trend-gate eligibility and clear leadership (rank 1, score 1.47, durability_bar 0.52, breadth 0.353). Momentum rank is a focus lens, not alpha, so this is a continuation lean conditioned on the absolute trend persisting — NOT a return forecast. The crowding flag is false and one_narrative is false, so no reflexive top signal is present to down-size against.
evidence: rank 1 with score 1.47, clear leader over Semiconductors at 0.802
hurst_tag 'mixed' — momentum not yet stretched to mean-revert territory
theses.dissent: The backtest says the trend gate did not hold on this market (mean-reverting tape), and hurst_tag is 'mixed', so the absolute trend itself may whipsaw; a rapid rotation off the leader is plausible given the 32% absorption level.

falsifier.text: 515000.SS lags the CSI 300 by more than 4% over the next 20 trading days.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the most crowded theme (crowded=true, crowding_z 1.58) yet the trend gate still marks them eligible. Crowding is a size-down caution only, but combined with the market-level gate_helps=false, the crowdedness argues for caution rather than participation. The high breadth (0.722) suggests broad but potentially late-stage participation.
evidence: crowded=true, crowding_z 1.58 — highest crowding of all eligible themes
eligibility retained (eligible=true) but durability_bar 0.63 is high relative to score 0.61
theses.dissent: Banks carry a value/growth hedge in a mean-reverting tape and high breadth could sustain the trend longer than crowding flags suggest; crowding has no validated forward edge as a sell signal.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS outperforms the CSI 300 by more than 3% over the next 20 trading days.
